name: Painel de Trabalho
description: See what you worked on by day, week and month: Claude Code and Codex time, tokens and estimated cost, your commits, a pomodoro timer and a to-do list. Everything stays on your machine. Interface in Portuguese (pt-BR).

cover.alt: The panel in Orca: weekly summary with active time, focus, cost, commits, time per project and bars per day, next to the session list.

screenshots.alt: Weekly summary with KPIs and sparklines, time per project, and a monthly view of estimated cost per day.
screenshots.caption: Day, week and month at a glance

screenshots.alt: List of Claude Code and Codex sessions with project, branch, time and cost, next to the list of commits grouped by day.
screenshots.caption: Every session and commit

screenshots.alt: Pomodoro running with the to-do list, next to the daily summary showing focus minutes per hour.
screenshots.caption: Pomodoro and tasks
